business_summary: Ming Fai International Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the manufacture and trading of hospitality supplies, and trading of operating supplies and equipment in Hong Kong, North America, Europe, China, Australia, other Asia Pacific regions, and internationally. It operates through three segments: Hospitality Supplies Business, OS&E Business, and Health Care and Hygienic Products Business. It offers room and bathing facility products, including body washes, shampoos, conditioners, body lotions, and hand soaps; guest room amenities solutions, such as tea boxes, notepads, trash bins, resin items, acrylic products, umbrellas, protective pads, vanity mirrors, ironing boards, and leather goods; and guest room appliances comprising safe boxes, electronic scales, refrigerators, electric kettles, telephones, hairdryers, irons, flashlights, and players. The company also provides lobby supplies, including signage, luggage carts, ashtray pillars, railing stands, trash bins, and floor mats; cleaning supplies, such as cleaning equipment, tools, and agents; and outdoor furniture comprising leisure chairs, loungers, hammocks, swings, and sun umbrellas. In addition, it provides linens and bedding solutions, including towels, bathrobes, tablecloths, bedsheets, blankets, pillows, work shoes, and accessories; ceramic solutions, such as porcelain sets, teacups, coffee utensils, glazed ceramics, Japanese and Korean ceramics, clay and stone pots, and earthenware; catering solutions comprising buffet stove and table arrangement solutions, catering consumables, and bakery supplies; kitchenware, including cutlery, pots, and Chinese kitchen cookware and utensils; and health care and hygienic products. Further, it is involved in the provision of professional solutions in product design, corporate branding, gifts and premiums, and event management services. Ming Fai International Holdings Limited was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Tsuen Wan, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Ming Fai International Holdings Limited는 홍콩, 북미, 유럽, 중국, 호주, 기타 아시아 태평양 지역 및 국제적으로 환대 용품의 제조 및 거래, 운영 용품 및 장비 거래에 종사하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 숙박용품 사업, OS&E 사업, 건강관리 및 위생용품 사업의 3개 부문으로 운영됩니다. 바디 워시, 샴푸, 컨디셔너, 바디 로션, 손 비누를 포함한 객실 및 목욕 시설 제품을 제공합니다. 차 상자, 메모장, 쓰레기통, 수지 제품, 아크릴 제품, 우산, 보호 패드, 화장 거울, 다리미판, 가죽 제품 등의 객실 편의 시설 솔루션; 금고, 전자저울, 냉장고, 전기 주전자, 전화기, 헤어드라이어, 다리미, 손전등, 플레이어로 구성된 객실 가전제품을 포함합니다. 이 회사는 또한 간판, 수하물 카트, 재떨이 기둥, 난간 스탠드, 쓰레기통 및 바닥 매트를 포함한 로비 용품을 제공합니다. 청소 장비, 도구 및 세제와 같은 청소 용품; 레저용 의자, 라운저, 해먹, 그네, 파라솔 등으로 구성된 야외용 가구 등이 있습니다. 게다가 프로다.
